keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: One search per keyword, e.g. "data centers", "broadband", "PFAS". Each keyword is searched across Congress bills, Federal Register documents, and Grants.gov opportunities.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How many days back to search across all three sources.

maxResultsPerSource.title: Max results per source
maxResultsPerSource.description: Cap on results returned from each of the three sources, per keyword.
